verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an official, documented Shopify CLI for generating and working with apps, themes and custom storefronts, including dev-store connection via `shopify app dev`. The Shopify AI Toolkit explicitly connects AI coding tools to CLI store management, which ties the CLI into AI-native workflows. missing for 10: documented agent-friendly CLI behaviors (e.g. machine-readable output or non-interactive modes), independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Shopify CLI is a command-line interface tool that helps you generate and work with Shopify apps, themes and custom storefronts.
Shopify AI Toolkit connects your AI coding tools to Shopify's developer docs, API schemas, and CLI store management so they can help you build more accurately.
You can connect directly to a dev store from Shopify CLI using the `shopify app dev` command.
Initialize new apps, themes, and headless storefronts in an instant with the latest Shopify CLI.
